buying_advice.size_advice: Sizes S through 4XL are listed. Reviews indicate generally good fitting, but one reviewer found the S version somewhat long. Shopi should recommend checking the size chart rather than guaranteeing fit.
buying_advice.fabric_advice: Describe the material as textured/lightweight fabric or linen-style fabric. Do not describe it as 100% linen or 100% cotton because the supplied source does not establish that.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Position the shirt as a good budget/value option rather than premium construction. Several customers like the fabric, but some explicitly say cloth quality could be improved.
buying_advice.value_advice: At approximately ₹409–₹495, the product has a strong value proposition. The ₹1,999 MRP should not be treated as evidence of premium quality.
buying_advice.occasion_advice: This product has broader occasion coverage than SHIRT-011: casual, vacation, beach, party and even semi-formal styling are supported by the source.
buying_advice.color_advice: Black is the safest versatile option. Beige and Chiku work well for neutral/earth-tone outfits. Light Blue and Pink are better for lighter summer styling. Maroon and Wine are stronger for party/evening looks.

care_instructions.source_instruction: Machine washable. Refer to the size chart before ordering.
